jobs.description: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter. At Mondelēz International, we craft iconic brands, creating moments of pure joy for consumers worldwide. Our Global Design team plays a key role in ensuring our brands remain world-class, and we're excited to offer a unique opportunity to shape the future of chocolate. As a Student Designer in our Design Hub, you'll play an integral part in project teams, helping to create brilliant and meaningful snacks that consumers love. You'll get to work on an array of design projects, from identifying exciting opportunities to transforming consumer insights and desires into concepts that meet real needs. Create and articulate new design concepts using design tools (sketching, rendering, 3D CAD etc.) to bring ideas to life. Support the briefing process, then collaborate with and guide the design delivery of external design resources. jobs.description: Join the Clean Energy Revolution Become an Investor Relations Financial Analyst at Edison International (EIX) and build a better tomorrow. In this job, you’ll work side-by-side with the Vice President and Principal Manager of Investor Relations to analyze financial and market information, develop investor-facing communications, and support engagement with investors and analysts—helping strengthen the investment community’s understanding of EIX and support the company’s long-term value. Investor Relations helps investors understand EIX’s strategy, financial performance, and long-term outlook while providing senior management with timely insights on market expectations, industry developments, and investor perspectives. The Investor Relations Financial Analyst supports this work by conducting financial and competitive analysis, developing investor-facing materials, owning recurring deliverables, and supporting engagement with investors and analysts. As an Investor Relations Financial Analyst , you’ll turn complex financial, operational, industry, and market information into clear, decision-useful insights and communications for investors, analysts, and senior management. You’ll analyze EIX’s performance relative to peers, monitor market expectations and investor sentiment, own recurring Investor Relations deliverables, and support the company’s engagement with the investment community. Responsibilities Prepares and revises financial analysis and presentations in support of management decision-making and communications. Conducts short and long-term financial modeling, maintains and develops models that can improve the ability to analyze strategic and financial data. Supports the analysis of potential investments, mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures across the organization. Provides timely, balanced forward looking financial assessments that capture current performance and help enable value optimized operational and financial decisions. Proactively identifies and manages financial risk through regular assessment and diligent execution of controls and mitigations, proactively raising any concerns. Supports monthly rolling forecasts and annual budgets, including analysis of variances for project, organizational unit, or corporate-wide financial forecasts. Assists in developing forecasting tools to help automate financial data analysis. A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity. Minimum Qualifications Three or more years of experience in financial planning, modeling and/or forecasting. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or higher in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, or related discipline. High proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word; experience involving extensive work with complex spreadsheets. Strong understanding of investor relations, corporate finance, stock valuations, and capital markets. Strong organizational and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail. Ability to synthesize large volumes of quantitative and qualitative information from multiple sources into clear, concise insights for senior management and external audiences. Effective interpersonal skills, as well as excellent oral and written communication skills. Strong financial acumen with knowledge of financial statement analysis. Ability to take initiative, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Team player with ability to work well with management, peers, other departments, and external parties. Additional Information This position’s work mode is hybrid. The employee will report to an SCE facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. Unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of California. Further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. The work mode can be changed based on business needs. jobs.description:
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
본 직무는 Coupang Ads 조직의 백엔드 개발자로서 쿠팡 광고 플랫폼의 새로운 기능을 개발 및 설계하는 역할을 수행하게 됩니다. 쿠팡은 세계 최고 수준의 광고 비즈니스를 구축하기 위한 투자를 하고 있으며, 쿠팡 웹사이트 및 모바일 앱 상에 위치한 주요 구좌에 연관성 있는 광고를 운영하고 있습니다. Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 판매자 및 공급자에게 셀프서비스 광고 운영 기능을 제공함으로써 쿠팡의 광고 솔루션을 보다 성장시키기 위한 차세대 프로덕트 및 서비스를 개발 중에 있습니다.
Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 광고 상품을 구현할 수 있는 시스템과 인프라를 개발할 열정적인 소프트웨어 개발자를 찾고 있습니다. 본 직무에는 그린필드 프로젝트 개발과 낮은 레이턴시 및 고가용성(availability) 서비스, 확장가능한 시스템, 프로그래매틱 연동을 위한 API 개발이 포함됩니다. 또한, 풀기 어려운 문제를 파악 및 해결하여 시스템의 확장성(scalability)과 신뢰성(reliability)을 향상시키는 작업과 효율적인 리소스 운영도 요구됩니다.
낮은 레이턴시와 높은 확장성을 갖춘 분산 서비스 개발에 관심이 있으신 분, 세계 최고 수준의 쿠팡 광고 비즈니스 구축이라는 큰 기회의 일원이 되고 싶으신 분, Coupang Ads 조직은 이러한 서비스를 함께 개발할 리더를 찾고 있습니다.

프론트엔드 개발자, 제품 관리자, 데이터 분석가, UX 디자이너를 포함한 cross-functional 팀과 긴밀하게 협업하여 원활하고 효율적인 솔루션을 제공함

All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
This role will involve the supervision of a team of hourly employees operating within SpaceXAI's logistics organization. Our goal is to become a leader in logistics performance with high inventory efficiency/accuracy and industry leading customer service while maintaining a safe work environment that utilizes the latest in applicable technologies. This supervisor will also be responsible for leading and driving continuous improvement throughout all aspects of their operations.

Manage an hourly workforce by assessing employee performance, providing positive/constructive feedback, facilitating conflict resolution, and addressing repeat issues with corrective actions, performance improvement plans or through disciplinary means
Lead by setting an example, taking feedback from all levels of the organization, and motivating your organization to achieve the highest level of results
Monitor and improve operations, ensuring a safe work environment with the goal of zero OSHA recordable annually
Manage the incoming acceptance, storing, and issuing of a wide variety of parts, details, and hardware into inventory
Manage operations that provide industry leading levels of customer service in all operations: recognizing the needs of the business and adapting to support our mission
Lead cost saving opportunities, identifying internal/external cost reductions and optimization opportunities
Ensure cycle counting procedures are routinely followed to meet both our internal and external audit requirements
Develop and maintain the appropriate service routes and material replenishments to deliver material to internal customers at agreed upon service levels
Supervise the local shipping and receiving operation; coordinate movements into and out of the local facility, along with critical point to point movements outside of the local facility
Drive projects and changes that contribute to logistics ongoing improvement
Ensure procedures are routinely being followed for shelf-life storage and maintaining proper rotation of stock and FIFO
Ensure the appropriate environmental controls are continuously effective, depending on the material requirements of the items being stored
Actively monitor and grow the workforce, ensuring team members are challenged and performing at the expected standards

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

Développer un contenu narratif captivant en accord avec le lore et les piliers de conception du jeu. Contribuer au développement de quêtes et d'aventures avec des arcs narratifs cohérents, convaincants et riches en rebondissements. Produire des scripts pour les voix hors champ, les réactions contextuelles et les quêtes. Produire et mettre à jour des documents de conception pour l'ensemble des éléments narratifs. Fusionner des éléments narratifs solides avec les fonctionnalités systémiques du jeu et les équilibrer. Identifier les problèmes narratifs et générer des solutions créatives avec des collègues Offrir et accepter des commentaires respectueusement lors de nos sessions de réflexion collective de révisions de gameplay et de lectures de table Collaborer avec ses collègues quotidiennement *** Gameloft Montreal is seeking a new Senior Narrative Designer to join the Dungeons & Dragons team. This innovative game will blend action-RPG/survival mechanics with unique life-simulation elements to redefine the genre and captivate the imaginations of players worldwide. The role of the narrative designer is to create and champion the game's narrative elements. They serve as the point of contact for all narrative-related matters (story, structure, characters, setting, dialogue, etc.). The narrative designer works closely with the project's level design team at every stage of development to create solid gameplay that balances mechanics, design, and structure, as well as the stories being told. The successful candidate will work and write alongside the lead narrative designer, level designers, and a team of dedicated, talented, and friendly narrative designers. Bring to life the personalities and voices of diverse characters and legendary creatures from the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Develop compelling narrative content aligned with the game's lore and design pillars. Contribute to the development of quests and adventures featuring coherent, compelling narrative arcs rich in plot twists. Write scripts for voiceovers, contextual reactions, and quests. Create and update design documentation for all narrative elements. Integrate compelling narrative elements with the game's systemic features and balance them.
